hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in backend/alembic/versions/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Migrations are generated via alembic revision --autogenerate, not hand-edited."}}';; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in .env|*/.env) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":".env holds live secrets; edit .env.example instead."}}';; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in backend/*.py) (cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix "${f#backend/}") 2>&1 || true;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in backend/*.py) (cd backend && uv run mypy "${f#backend/}") 2>&1 || true;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in frontend/src/*.ts|frontend/src/*.tsx) (cd frontend && bun run test -- "$(basename "${f%.*}")" --run) 2>&1 || true;; esac; }
